story: At 4:17 on this breezy, clear Monday afternoon, Gary, Donna, Hal, and Rosa are all gathered at Rosa's House, where the mood is warm and easy. Gary, feeling optimistic, asks Hal for pointers on filing an Architectural Review form for his cart's parade lights and sound system, and Hal dutifully explains the rules under L-01. Donna cheerfully teases Gary about their Tuesday tennis plans, while Rosa, delighted to have Hal there, saves him a seat at the head of the table and promises to finally pin down that coffee date.

gary.thought_process: I just got to Rosa's with Donna and Hal, and Rosa's right here too. My reflections say they both nudged me toward Architectural Review, and I've come around: better to file the form than get in trouble over unapproved parade lights. Hal's here and he knows the process, and Donna's a friend, so this is a good moment to ask for help with the form instead of wandering off. Donna and I already have Tuesday on the court sorted, so no need to repeat that. I'll ask Hal to walk me through the cart lights filing.

parameters.content: Hal, good timing. You've been through the Architectural Review form before, haven't you? I'd like to file for the parade lights and sound system on my cart, and I'd take any pointers on what they look for.

donna.thought_process: Gary just walked in, and my whole mission is getting him on my side as a doubles partner for the ladder. We're already booked for Tuesday, so I don't need to ask again. Best move is to be warm, remind him I'm counting on him, and keep it light while we wait on Hal. Rosa's table is a nice spot to make it feel like a team.

parameters.content: Gary, there's my partner! Those third-shot drops have me dreaming about the top of the ladder. Tuesday, courts, bring that wrist.

hal.thought_process: Gary, Donna, and Rosa are all here at Rosa's House. Not the place for formal complaints, but Gary's cart wiring needs paperwork under L-01, and I'd rather give him a fair warning face to face before it goes to the committee. Soft-hearted underneath, but rules are rules. Keep it short and dry.

parameters.content: Gary. That parade wiring on your cart is visible from the street, so it needs Architectural Review approval under L-01. File the paperwork before those lights go on again, or I'll have to.

rosa.thought_process: Hal just walked in, and all three neighbors are finally in my house at once, which is exactly what I've wanted. Gary and Donna are already settled, so the best move is to welcome Hal warmly, point him to the chair I saved, and not let the coffee-with-Hal plan drift again. I'll greet him now and tell him the chair is his.

parameters.content: Hal, there you are! I saved you the chair at the head of the table, so come sit. And I'm putting coffee with you in ink this week, no more excuses from me.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
